title: Fixed-Point State-Space
text: Implement discrete-time state space, 1 input, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Initial condition for state} sets Initial state vector; {State Matrix A} sets the matrix of states, {Input Matrix B} sets the column vector of inputs {Output Matrix C} sets the column vector of outputs, {Direct Feedthrough Matrix D} sets the matrix for direct feedthrough, {Data type for internal calculations}, {Scaling for State Equation AX+BU} sets the scaling for state, {Scaling for Output Equation CX+DU} sets the scaling for output, {Lock output data type setting against changes by the fixed-point tools} prevents fixed-point tools from overriding data, {Integer rounding mode} sets the rounding mode for fixed-point operations and {Saturate to max or min when overflows occur} sets the method of overflow action. Values come from the instance.

params.name: State Matrix A
params.values: Matrix of states [2.6020 -2.2793 0.6708; 1 0 0; 0 1 0] (default) | scalar | vector | matrix

params.name: Input Matrix B
params.values: Column vector of inputs [ 1; 0; 0] (default) | scalar | vector | matrix

params.name: Output Matrix C
params.values: Column vector of outputs [0.0184 0.0024 0.0055] (default) | scalar | vector | matrix

params.name: Direct Feedthrough Matrix D
params.values: Matrix for direct feedthrough [0.0033] (default) | scalar | vector | matrix

params.name: Initial condition for state
params.values: Initial state vector 0.0 (default) | scalar | vector | matrix

params.name: Data type for internal calculations
params.values: Data type for internal calculations fixdt(’double’) (default) | data type string

params.name: Lock output data type setting against changes by the fixed-point tools
params.values: Prevent fixed-point tools from overriding data types off (default) | on

params.name: Integer rounding mode
params.values: Rounding mode for fixed-point operations Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Simplest | Zero

params.name: Saturate to max or min when overflows occur
params.values: Method of overflow action off (default) | on
